samples.comment: An AI Bot did not answer my specific question. It just spit out the marketing specs which is not wa=hat I asked.
I got a response from AI about my suggestions. Sad to see that. I hope there is a more thought out form factor and features for the next generation of Reactor.

I opened a case and was asked to provide additional details on proof of purchase, receipts, etc. I did and was told that my case was being handed off to a human support staff to be fulfilled. I never heard back. I had to open another case and after many more emails I was once again told that my product would be shipped. I provided all my contact information and mailing address but then I had to go in with a discount code and order the product myself instead of someone just sending it out the first time, to the address I was asked to provide. This was one of the most frustrating customer service experiences I've encountered. I have purchased a lot of your products, but your customer service makes me question if I will continue to do so.
Ai support tool closed out my ticket before agent even looked at it
Eventhough I provided all the information regarding the problem and explained the steps I had already followed, different agents or bots kept asking me for information I'd already given

I contacted the team quickly after ordering to request cancellation. Although the item had not shipped I was told it was too late as it was already with the warehouse team. I waited for the item to arrive and immediately requested a refund. It took three attempts and escalating the request to receive the return slip.  I then had to take a $35 hit to ship the item back for a refund. My main feedback is that I don’t think your AI chatbot is working well enough and it feels really inefficient to get answers.

I would prefer a response from an actual human not an AI. I would appreciate an indication of when your products will likely go on sale so I can make an informed decision. 


I'm sure you have a good idea when your products will go on sale. I am not in a position to afford them at full price and if I knew when they are going on sale I could save and plan around that.

As I received only answer from AI I'm not sure it's true and related to the last version (Spark 2) of the product.
In the doubt, I won't purchase the product I was expecting.
Kind regards
